description: This file defines the HomeViewModel class for an Android application, managing UI state for a streaming service homepage. It includes data classes for representing UI state (RailState and BannerState), handles loading categories and banners asynchronously, and exposes state flows for observing UI updates.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: Represents the UI state for a media rail/section, including loading state, error message, title, and list of ContentItem objects.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel responsible for managing the home screen's state, including categories and banners, with functions to load, reload, and handle loading states.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Triggers loading of all predefined categories in parallel.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Triggers reloading of a specific category.

methods.name: loadBanners
methods.description: Loads banner data from the repository, updating loading and error states.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Private helper method to load a single category's items, updating the UI state accordingly.
